device.description: 12-bit 200-500 kSPS fully differential SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: adc121s655.pdf (SNAS402A) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.4 output coding, p.5 timing specifications, p.6 timing diagrams, p.20 serial interface and data output

pages: p.1 (pinout: VREF1 +IN2 -IN3 GND4 CS5 DOUT6 SCLK7 VA8), p.2 (pin descriptions: 4 null bits + 12 data bits MSB first, output on falling edges, valid on rising edges), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 4.5-5.5 V, digital inputs 0 to VA, SCLK 3.2-8 MHz), p.4 (binary 2's complement), p.5 (tEN 20 ns, tDA 22 ns, tDIS 20 ns), p.6 (Figure 1 single, Figure 2 continuous conversion), p.20 (falling edges 1-4 leading zeros, 5-16 result; a new conversion every 16 SCLKs while CS stays low)
notModeled: differential analog input (the result is the 0 V code 0x000)
conversion clocked by SCLK; continuous conversions while CS stays low are modeled by repeating the 16-bit frame (idle "repeat"); each repeated result is the same 0 V code
SPI mode 0 chosen (CS may also fall with SCLK high: the first SCLK fall then starts acquisition)
power-down while CS is high (no visible digital effect), CS high before the 16th falling edge aborts the conversion
variants: Table 1 pin-compatible family by speed (ADC121S625 50-200 kSPS, other datasheet); NRND part
